subject: Ciências
description_pt: Analisar o ciclo evolutivo do Sol (nascimento, vida e morte) baseado no conhecimento das etapas de evolução de estrelas de diferentes dimensões e os efeitos desse processo no nosso planeta.

components.description_pt: Descrever etapas do ciclo de vida do Sol desde formação até eventual extinção
components.description_en: Describe the stages of the sun's life cycle from formation to eventual burnout
components.cc_component_description: Describe the stages of the sun's life cycle from formation to eventual burnout

components.description_pt: Explicar como a massa de uma estrela determina suas etapas evolutivas e estado final
components.description_en: Explain how the mass of a star determines its evolutionary stages and final state
components.cc_component_description: Communicate how different stellar life-cycle stages produce elements of varying atomic mass

components.description_pt: Comparar ciclo evolutivo do Sol com aquele de estrelas de diferentes tamanhos
components.description_en: Compare the evolutionary cycle of the Sun with that of stars of different sizes
components.cc_component_description: Develop a model illustrating the stages and approximate lifespan of the sun

components.description_pt: Analisar efeitos do ciclo evolutivo do Sol em condições na Terra
components.description_en: Analyze the effects of the Sun's evolutionary cycle on conditions on Earth
components.cc_component_description: Use evidence to support a model connecting nuclear processes in the sun to energy received on Earth

cc_matches.description: The star called the sun is changing and will burn out over a lifespan of approximately 10 billion years.
Develop a model based on evidence to illustrate the life span of the sun and the role of nuclear fusion in the sun’s core to release energy that eventually reaches Earth in the form of radiation.
Communicate scientific ideas about the way stars, over their life cycle, produce elements.
